rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides AI agents with full access to Planka kanban boards through comprehensive tools for project management, board operations, card manipulation, custom fields, labels, attachments, and task lists. Features dual transport modes (stdio and SSE), OAuth 2.0 authentication with PKCE, local PostgreSQL storage for metadata and board configurations, and auto-attachment capabilities for chat provider links. Supports advanced card search with custom field filtering, bulk operations, and per-user isolated data storage.
